purpose_context: Ruslan needs a self-owned Beads distribution that can consume upstream safely while remaining compatible with the Spec Kitty fork. The fork begins behavior-identical to upstream, owns its tracker and release identity, accepts upstream updates only through reviewed pull requests, and proves Windows and Linux build compatibility before any active bd replacement.
purpose_tldr: Make Ruslan's Beads fork reproducible and independently maintainable without premature behavior divergence.
